title: AiMeCredentialV1
description: ai.me-credential@1 (OpenVibe.AI; L36 Y1): one of the person's own provider keys as the person reads it from GET /api/v1/me/credentials. It is never the key: `hint` is the last four characters, and `last_error` is a redacted line that never carries the key. `status` is what the last save-time or run-time check found: ok, failing or untested. `models_count` is how many models the provider listed when it was last tested. Own keys are free to their owner: no fee, no cap and no network budget.

hint.description: The key's last four characters, so the person can tell two keys apart. Never more.

base_url.description: The endpoint the person chose, or null for the provider's own (taken from the console presets).

budget_usd_per_day.description: The person's own daily cap on this key; null or 0 means no cap. The network's budgets never apply to their own key.

last_error.description: Why the key last failed, with the key and any other secret redacted. Never the key itself.
